description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Strea…” illustrates the runtime (in seconds) for different approaches/models, contrasting “Our Joint Framework” with several “LLM Models” as indicated by the legend (dark green for Our Joint Framework and light blue for LLM Models). The category axis is horizontal and lists the models from left to right as: Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude; the value axis is vertical, labeled “Runtime (seconds),” shown on a linear scale with numeric ticks spanning roughly from 0 up to about 400 seconds (with regularly spaced tick marks visible). Each category has a single bar with a black outline and a numeric value label above it: Our Joint Framework is a dark-green bar at approximately 77 seconds; ChatGPT is a light-blue bar at approximately 190 seconds; DeepSeek is a light-blue bar at approximately 365 seconds; LLaMA is a light-blue bar at approximately 172 seconds; and Claude is a light-blue bar at approximately 243 seconds. The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond the single-series-per-category layout, and there is no visual emphasis such as shading differences beyond the two legend-defined colors; the categories appear in a fixed left-to-right listing rather than being explicitly sorted by value.
